Use Root with Media and Content, then nest Title and Description inside Content. Place independent controls in Actions.

## Usage

```ts
import { item, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/item';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/item`. It [registers](../../registration/) 10 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-item-root"></a>

### `shadcn.Item.Root`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.Item`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `id` | `null \| string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `size` | `"default" \| "xs" \| "sm"` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |
| `variant` | `"default" \| "outline" \| "muted"` |  |

<details>
<summary>Additional HTML and ARIA inputs</summary>

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `null \| string` |  |
| `data-disabled` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-icon` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-invalid` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `role` | `string` |  |
| `style` | `string` |  |

This part also supports the [listed shared inputs](../../attributes/#attributes-c337cc7871).

</details>

Slots `child`, `default`.

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
